summary: A 3-day high-altitude adventure through Hunza Valley featuring glacier views, ancient forts, and Karakoram landscapes.

days.title: Arrival & Karimabad
activities: Arrive in Hunza, check into guesthouse
Dinner at a local Hunzakut kitchen

days.title: Attabad & Passu
activities: Hike to the Hussaini suspension bridge

days.title: Eagle's Nest & Departure
activities: Walk through Altit village and old fort

tips: Carry cash — ATMs are unreliable in the valley
Acclimatize before the Khunjerab leg if you go further north
Respect local customs and dress modestly
